officialRecurringEvents.title: Storytime in the Nature Garden
officialRecurringEvents.description: Interactive storytime in the Nature Gardens for caregivers and children ages 0-5, led by Museum Educators.
officialRecurringEvents.venue: Natural History Museum of Los Angeles County

officialRecurringEvents.title: Dinosaur Encounters
officialRecurringEvents.description: Live theater performance where dinosaurs come to life through large-scale puppets. Friday through Sunday, 11 am and 1:45 pm; schedule varies.
officialRecurringEvents.venue: Natural History Museum of Los Angeles County

officialRecurringEvents.title: Dinosaur Hall Tour
officialRecurringEvents.description: Explore the Dinosaur Hall with a Museum Educator and learn about the fascinating world of dinosaurs.
officialRecurringEvents.venue: Natural History Museum of Los Angeles County

officialRecurringEvents.title: Meet a Live Animal
officialRecurringEvents.description: Get up close with the Museum's resident animals and hear amazing stories about critters that are often misunderstood or overlooked.
officialRecurringEvents.venue: Natural History Museum of Los Angeles County

sources.name: MacArthur Park Free Summer Concert: Country/Mexican Regional

officialTextEvents.title: MacArthur Park Free Summer Concert: Country/Mexican Regional
officialTextEvents.description: Free outdoor summer concert at MacArthur Park (formerly Levitt Pavilion LA, now MAC-LA), Country/Mexican Regional. All-ages, family-friendly. Bring a picnic.

sources.name: An Evening with Ciro Hurtado and Friends — Grand Performances

officialTextEvents.title: An Evening with Ciro Hurtado and Friends — Grand Performances
officialTextEvents.description: Free outdoor world/Andean guitar concert presented by Grand Performances at California Plaza in downtown LA. Free with RSVP; all-ages, family-friendly.
requiredText: An Evening with Ciro Hurtado and Friends

sources.name: Bees & Things & Flowers: Roy Ayers Tribute + J Dilla's Donuts — Grand Performances

officialTextEvents.title: Bees & Things & Flowers: Roy Ayers Tribute + J Dilla's Donuts — Grand Performances
officialTextEvents.description: Free outdoor concert at California Plaza: a Roy Ayers tribute by Sly5thAve with Kassa Overall, plus Linafornia celebrating J Dilla's 'Donuts'. Free, all-ages series; an evening music program best for older kids, teens and adults.

sources.name: Sounds of LA County: Selectors Choice DJ Dance Party at Helen Keller Park

officialTextEvents.title: Sounds of LA County: Selectors Choice DJ Dance Party at Helen Keller Park
officialTextEvents.description: Free outdoor concert in the Sounds of LA County series, LA County Parks' first standalone free summer concert series. Selectors Choice curates an interactive DJ dance party with workshops featuring DIAMONIQUE, DRUMMINGLATINA, DJ HI-NOTE, DJ 5150 Steph, and DJ C-Los.

sources.name: Sounds of LA County: Lily H Clark featuring Guicho y La Tribu at Lennox Park

officialTextEvents.title: Sounds of LA County: Lily H Clark featuring Guicho y La Tribu at Lennox Park
officialTextEvents.description: Free outdoor Latin and salsa concert night at Lennox Park in the Sounds of LA County series, with Lily H Clark featuring Guicho y La Tribu, DJ Byron, and an interactive salsa lesson led by Annet. Park staff give out food samples, fresh popcorn, and snow cones while supplies last. Bring lawn chairs and blankets.
requiredText: Lily H Clark featuring Guicho y La Tribu

sources.name: Sounds of LA County: Resonance & Remedies at William Steinmetz Park

officialTextEvents.title: Sounds of LA County: Resonance & Remedies at William Steinmetz Park
officialTextEvents.description: Free outdoor concert at William Steinmetz Park in the Sounds of LA County series. Curated by Nancy Arteaga (Nance Arte Productions), an eclectic evening of space-age tropicalia lounge, conscious reggae, and soulful selectors with Healing Gems, Eureka Sound, and DJ Sonido Sapo.

sources.name: 3rd Annual Dena Community Backpack Giveaway at Rose Bowl Stadium

officialTextEvents.title: 3rd Annual Dena Community Backpack Giveaway at Rose Bowl Stadium
officialTextEvents.description: Free bilingual back-to-school event at Rose Bowl Stadium hosted by the Rose Bowl Institute with Neighborhood Servants, the Pasadena Educational Foundation, and Project Passion. Backpacks with school supplies, community resource tables, activities, and the rare chance to play on the Rose Bowl field. Registration required for students; parents and guardians do not need a ticket, and walk-ups are welcomed by the stadium.

officialTextEvents.title: Nisei Week Grand Parade
officialTextEvents.description: The Grand Parade of the 86th annual Nisei Week Japanese Festival through historic Little Tokyo in downtown Los Angeles, produced by the Nisei Week Foundation. One of the longest-running cultural festivals in the United States.

officialTextEvents.title: Nisei Week Plaza Festival
officialTextEvents.description: Family-friendly Nisei Week festival day at the Japanese American Cultural and Community Center (JACCC) plaza in Little Tokyo, with food, games, booths, and live entertainment.

sources.name: International Surf Festival: Dwight Crum Pier-to-Pier Swim

officialTextEvents.title: International Surf Festival: Dwight Crum Pier-to-Pier Swim
officialTextEvents.description: The signature event of the 2026 International Surf Festival: roughly 2,000 swimmers race from Hermosa Beach Pier to Manhattan Beach Pier. Watching from the sand is free; the first heat starts at 9:00 am and the finish line on Manhattan Beach is the best spot for families.
officialTextEvents.cost: Free to watch from the beach (swimmer entry requires paid registration)

officialTextEvents.title: Sawdust Art Festival (60th Summer Festival)
officialTextEvents.description: Artist-built village of 180+ Laguna Beach artists under the eucalyptus trees, running daily all summer. Kids can watch glassblowing and ceramics demos live, there are free hands-on workshops, and three stages of live music. Open 11am, until 10pm on Friday and Saturday.
officialTextEvents.cost: $12.50 single-day ticket; free for children under 5
requiredText: Celebrating 60 Years of Art and Artists

sources.name: 44th Annual Watts Towers Day of the Drum Festival

officialTextEvents.title: 44th Annual Watts Towers Day of the Drum Festival
officialTextEvents.description: A free day-long celebration of percussion at the Watts Towers Arts Center Campus, featuring Latin, Japanese, African, Jazz, Native American, and other drumming traditions. Tours of the historic Watts Towers run throughout the day. Presented by the City of Los Angeles Department of Cultural Affairs.
requiredText: 44th Annual Watts Towers Day of the Drum Festival

officialTextEvents.title: Abbot Kinney Festival
officialTextEvents.description: Venice's biggest street festival returns to Abbot Kinney Boulevard, drawing crowds of over 100,000 for live music stages, an artisan and vendor marketplace, food, and a kids' area. Produced by the nonprofit Abbot Kinney Festival Association, which grants the proceeds to Venice youth, community, and arts programs.
